Media buying is now the easy part. 
 In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.
 So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.
 Here's what "end to end" actually means here.
 You are the account manager. We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You are the creative strategist. You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.
 You build the things the account needs. If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You carry up to six accounts. That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.
 You can live anywhere. We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 We're growing fast and we keep the bar high. 
 We believe the best media buyer today is a sharp marketer who uses AI every day. We built an internal creative analysis tool that connects to Claude, and we use Pipeboard to read and write to ad accounts and run heavy analysis. You don't need to know our stack yet. You do need to actually use AI in your work, not be afraid of it, and teach yourself what you don't know.
 What the job looks like
 Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.
 Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.
 Run the research before the ads. Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in this account.
 Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work. Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.
 Ship creative on a cadence. Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.
 Build and test landing pages. Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Report on new customer economics. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.
 You're a fit if
 You've done this with real money. Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.
 You're AI-native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.
 You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level. Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.
 You can communicate your ideas. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.
 You have taste and you know when to hand off. You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.
 You're not a fit if
 "That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary. It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 Why This Role Is Exciting
 This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets.  We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You will grow into senior strategy.  We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments. 
 When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. 
 AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

On cherche un(e) chasseur(euse). 
 Le rôle : 
 Ton meilleur souvenir professionnel, c'est ce compte que personne ne croyait possible d'ouvrir et que tu as ouvert quand même?
 Tu ne cherches pas un portefeuille à gérer, tu cherches un territoire à conquérir? Continue à lire. 
 Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable du développement commercial sénior pour joindre l'équipe de Go RH. Poste permanent, temps plein, mode hybride , avec un seul mandat : faire du Grand-Montréal notre prochain terrain de croissance.
 Relevant de notre Directrice développement des affaires et expérience client , tu vas chercher de nouveaux comptes stratégiques, autant chez les PME en croissance que dans les grandes entreprises. Tu t'assois avec ceux qui décident : haute direction, vice-présidences, directions RH et opérations. Pas de gardien de porte, pas de comité qui traîne, tu montes directement au sommet.
 C'est un vrai rôle de hunter : tu détiens l'ensemble du cycle, du premier appel jusqu'à la signature. Aucun portefeuille hérité, aucun pipeline prémâché.
 Le territoire est là. Le nom est là. La table est mise. Le reste, c'est toi. 
 À propos de Go RH : 
 Chez Go RH, nous accompagnons les entreprises québécoises dans leur transformation et leur croissance en offrant des solutions RH et de recrutement sur mesure. Notre mission : accompagner nos clients grâce à notre écosystème intégré d'expertises en ressources humaines et en recrutement afin de répondre à leurs besoins humains, stratégiques et organisationnels.
 Depuis 2017, nous avons aidé plus de 1000 organisations à optimiser leurs pratiques et à bâtir des équipes performantes. Notre notoriété ouvre des portes; tu es la personne qui les franchit. Et ce que tu vends, nos équipes le livrent, ta réputation ne sera jamais l'otage de notre exécution.
 Nos valeurs : Créativité , Authenticité , Pertinence et Plaisir (On garde le CAPP) se vivent dans la façon dont on travaille, dont on se parle, et dont on grandit ensemble.
 Tes responsabilités professionnelles : 
 La chasse - Développement des affaires et croissance (70 %) 
 Ton pipeline, tes cibles, tes signatures 
 Pipeline de ventes : bâtir et gérer ton pipeline de nouveaux clients, de la PME en croissance à la grande entreprise.
 Prospection : aller chercher tes propres occasions d'affaires : appels à froid, marketing par courriel, rencontres, maturation et qualification, jusqu'à la conclusion des ventes. Personne ne remplira ton agenda à ta place, et c'est exactement ce qui te plaît.
 Intelligence d'affaires : analyser notre base de données clients inactifs afin d'y déterrer de nouvelles occasions de vente.
 Cibles de revenus : atteindre, puis dépasser les objectifs de revenus et de rentabilité, par une vente consultative axée sur le besoin réel du client.
 Le terrain - Relations d'affaires et rayonnement (20 %) 
 En collaboration étroite avec notre VP rayonnement et notre équipe marketing 
 Relations avec les décideurs : bâtir des relations de confiance durables avec la haute direction, les vice-présidences et les directions RH et opérations.
 Ton réseau : mettre ton carnet d'adresses au travail : ton réseau et ta notoriété deviennent des opportunités qualifiées.
 Représentation : porter les couleurs de Go RH lors des événements d'affaires et te déplacer pour rencontrer les clients et créer de nouvelles relations.
 La suite - Collaboration et expérience client (10 %) 
 En collaboration étroite avec nos équipes services-conseils, recrutement et direction 
 Compréhension des besoins : cerner les défis RH et organisationnels de chaque client et proposer des solutions alignées sur ses objectifs d'affaires.
 Suivi client : assurer un suivi rigoureux et maintenir une communication constante et agréable avec tes clients potentiels.
 Maîtrise de notre offre : développer une connaissance approfondie des services Go RH pour lier les enjeux de nos clients à la valeur de nos expertises.
 Transition interne : collaborer avec les équipes internes pour assurer un passage fluide entre la signature et la livraison, et résoudre proactivement les enjeux des clients.
 Stratégie commerciale : contribuer au positionnement de notre offre de services et à la stratégie de développement.
 Transition vers les farmers : effectuer une passation impeccable et bien documentée des comptes afin de positionner l'équipe de farmers pour le succès des renouvellements et des ventes croisées.
 Le profil recherché : 
 Si tu te reconnais dans les cinq premières lignes, on veut te parler 
 Expérience : 5 à 10 ans d'expérience démontrée en vente de services (services-conseils, services professionnels ou solutions B2B), avec des résultats à l'appui.
 Type d’entreprises : expérience concrète auprès d'organisations de tailles variées, incluant la grande entreprise : tu maîtrises les processus décisionnels et les cycles d'achat complexes.
 Réseau : un réseau d'affaires étendu et une notoriété établie dans le milieu des affaires.
 Habiletés relationnelles : une capacité reconnue à établir des liens de confiance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et plus.
 Expertise technique : connaissance des outils CRM et rigueur dans la gestion du pipeline.
 Compétences linguistiques : maîtrise parfaite du français (oral et écrit) et maîtrise de l'anglais (oral et écrit).
 Mobilité : disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents et permis de conduire valide.
 Atout : expérience ou connaissance du domaine des ressources humaines (services-conseils RH, recrutement, impartition).
 Attitude : tu es autonome, orienté(e) résultats et tenace. Un refus est une information, pas un frein : tu passes au prochain appel. Ton flair d'affaires et ta curiosité font que tu décèles le besoin avant même qu'on te l'exprime.
 Ce que nous offrons : 
 Rémunération : un salaire de base compétitif établi selon ton expérience, bonifié d'une structure de commissions réellement motivante ( uncap avec accélérateur);
 Flexibilité : un horaire de 40 h par semaine, du lundi au vendredi, avec une flexibilité favorisant la conciliation travail-vie personnelle.
 Mode hybride : possibilité de télétravail combinée à une présence aux co-works, chez les clients et sur le terrain.
 Avantages sociaux : gamme complète incluant assurances collectives (avec compte santé et dentaire), service de télémédecine et PAE.
 Épargne : participation à un régime d'épargne-retraite avec contribution de l'employeur.
 Liberté d’action : un accès direct à la direction, un territoire à bâtir et la liberté de façonner ton propre plan de chasse. On mise sur l'autonomie, pas sur la surveillance.
 Culture : un milieu de travail stimulant, un club social actif et une culture d'entreprise forte basée sur le « CAPP ».
 Ça te parle? Envoie ta candidature dès aujourd'hui et viens ouvrir le Grand-Montréal avec nous ! 
 Notre demande particulière : Raconte-nous en deux paragraphes ta meilleure histoire de chasse : le compte que tu as ouvert et dont tu es encore fier(ère). On veut voir comment tu pitches.

About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In this role, you will:

 - Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

 - Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

 - Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.

 - Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.

 - Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.

 - Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.

 - Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.

 - Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.

 - Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.

 - Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.

 - Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.

 - Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.

 - Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.

 - Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands-on diagnosis of complex production issues.

 - Have expert-level troubleshooting skills and a strong track record of resolving ambiguous technical problems across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations.

 - Are comfortable working with logs, metrics, traces, API requests, authentication flows, and customer-provided code or configurations to understand system behavior and test hypotheses.

 - Have experience leading or playing a central role in customer-impacting incidents, including severity assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through.

 - Can write code or scripts to reproduce issues, interrogate systems, automate repetitive work, and improve internal tools. Experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages is valuable.

 - Can communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders—especially when information is incomplete or evolving.

 - Build strong, high-trust relationships with customers and cross-functional partners while maintaining clear and scalable ownership boundaries.

 - Look beyond the immediate issue to identify patterns, improve the system, and prevent the same problem from recurring.

 - Thrive in ambiguity, update quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to learn whatever is needed to get the job done.

 - Bring a humble, team-first mindset, strong judgment, and a genuine eagerness to help both customers and colleagues succeed.

 - Are excited to use OpenAI’s products, agents, and emerging AI capabilities to transform how technical support operates at scale.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

 Ce que vous ferez: 
 La ou le responsable de produit, Service des infrastructures de surveillance et d’observabilité est responsable de la stratégie, de la feuille de route, de la gouvernance et de l’efficacité du service, et doit renforcer les capacités nécessaires pour fournir progressivement des renseignements opérationnels exploitables. En tant que contributeur clé de l’Équipe des activités et des services technologiques à la stratégie d’EDC en matière d’observabilité, la personne choisie collaborera avec l’Équipe d’architecture d’entreprise, les architectes et d’autres parties prenantes afin de définir l’orientation et de la traduire en priorités et capacités technologiques.
 Prendre en charge et adapter le Service des infrastructures de surveillance et d’observabilité de l’Équipe des activités et des services technologiques conformément à l’architecture et à la stratégie d’EDC en matière d’observabilité.
 Définir la vision, les capacités et le modèle opérationnel du service en traduisant l’orientation de l’entreprise en une feuille de route pluriannuelle hiérarchisée et en une liste de tâches.
 Renforcer l’observabilité des applications et des applications globales à l’aide s dépendances, journaux, mesures, traces et autres données télémétriques afin d’améliorer la surveillance proactive et l’analyse des causes profondes et des répercussions, ainsi que de fournir des renseignements opérationnels exploitables.
 Définir et mesurer le rendement du service, notamment les indicateurs de niveau de service, les objectifs de niveau de service, le taux d’adoption, l’état de santé de la plateforme et la réalisation de valeur, ainsi que produire des rapports en la matière.
 Assurer la gestion des plateformes d’observabilité, notamment Dynatrace, de manière à en superviser la santé, les accès, la consommation, le cycle de vie et la gestion des coûts.
 Orienter l’intégration avec l’outil Event Management de ServiceNow et collaborer avec les équipes responsables de la gestion des services de technologie de l’information, de la gestion des opérations de TI et de la BDGC afin d’établir les processus et infrastructures de données nécessaires pour une gestion des événements et une observabilité efficaces.
 Gérer et améliorer de manière continue la réception, la hiérarchisation et le flux des demandes du Service d’observabilité et de surveillance.
 Collaborer avec les responsables des produits, les architectes, les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes au sein de l’organisation afin de comprendre les besoins en matière d’observabilité, de favoriser l’adoption des solutions et de traduire les exigences en capacités de service.
 Gérer les relations avec les principaux fournisseurs et prestataires de services gérés, notamment en ce qui concerne les licences, les contrats, le rendement des fournisseurs, la portée de prestation et les escalades hiérarchiques.
 Fournir des commentaires techniques et opérationnels visant à orienter les décisions de l’Équipe d’architecture d’entreprise quant à l’évolution et à la rationalisation des technologies d’observabilité et de surveillance.
 Participer activement à la communauté de pratique des responsables de produit d’EDC et veiller à ce que le service soit conforme aux normes de produits applicables.

 Diplôme universitaire ou collégial en informatique, en systèmes d’information, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou combinaison équivalente d’études et d’expérience

 Expérience de la surveillance d’entreprise et des concepts d’observabilité, notamment les mesures, les journaux, les traces, les événements, les alertes, les tableaux de bord, la visibilité des dépendances, la surveillance du rendement des applications ou la surveillance de l’expérience numérique
 Expérience en tant que responsable de produit, responsable de service ou responsable de plateforme, notamment dans la traduction de l’architecture et de la stratégie d’entreprise en feuilles de route techniques, en listes de tâches et en capacités de service
 Expérience en intégration de capacités de surveillance ou d’observabilité, notamment l’outil Event Management, dans les plateformes et processus de gestion des services de technologie de l’information et de gestion des opérations de TI
 Expérience de travail dans un environnement externalisé ou de services gérés, notamment la surveillance de fournisseurs de services, de fournisseurs et de tiers
 Expérience de la gestion de fournisseurs, de l’attribution de licences, de la planification de la consommation, de la préparation de budgets et du soutien de l’élaboration d’investissements et d’analyses de rentabilisation
 Capacité avérée à collaborer avec les équipes sectorielles, techniques et d’architecture afin de traduire les normes de l’entreprise en services opérationnels et en priorités d’exécution claires
 Solides compétences en matière d’analyse, de communication, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes, et capacité à traduire les capacités techniques en résultats opérationnels
 Ce qui vous distinguera: 
 Expérience des logiciels Dynatrace, ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Cisco ThousandEyes, Cisco Digital Networking Architecture Center, VMware Aria Suite, Microsoft Configuration Manager ou d’autres technologies comparables
 Connaissance technique de la surveillance de l’expérience numérique, de la surveillance du rendement des applications, de la surveillance de base, de la surveillance du rendement du réseau, de l’analyse des journaux et du traçage distribué
 Connaissance de la gestion des opérations de TI et de l’outil Event Management de ServiceNow, des dépendances de la BDGC et de l’intégration de la chaîne « événement, alerte, incident »

 Connaissance des méthodes de surveillance des environnements infonuagiques, hybrides et SaaS, notamment les environnements Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365
 Connaissances des opérations en matière d’intelligence artificielle, de l’automatisation, des réponses opérationnelles en boucle fermée, de la gouvernance des accès aux plateformes, de la conservation des données, de la gestion de la consommation et des principes des activités de financement

Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Senior Research Engineer. 
 About the team: 
 The Huawei Digital Trust Lab is on a mission to enhance consumer, embedded and enterprise computing platforms by building security features from the ground up. We believe that everyone deserves to have a secure computing foundation to build upon. Our research lab collaborates with product and customer facing departments to understand the most challenging system and data security problems, analyzing and prototyping promising technologies, and delivering solutions to achieve the highest customer value. 
 Research focuses on key areas such as authentication & authorization, kernel & hardware security, data security, ai agent security, advancement of agentic ai for product security. The lab supports deep research and encourages publications in leading journals. Research outcomes are applied across various Huawei product lines, including mobile phones, smart devices, and communications technologies. 
 About the job: 
 Research and design cutting-edge AI data security architectures and privacy protection technology blueprints specifically tailored for endpoint devices (including desktops, laptops, and mobile devices), ensuring secure data lifecycles in next-generation computing environments. 
 Propose, prototype, and build innovative AI data security and privacy-preserving solutions for Huawei Endpoint products, driving the transition of advanced security theories into high-impact, production-grade defenses. 
 Investigate global technology developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging attack vectors across both academia and industry, producing actionable insights to continuously fortify endpoint AI systems against sophisticated data threats. 
 Collaborate closely with global research labs and product engineering teams worldwide to optimize end-to-end security solutions, accelerating the integration of research prototypes into real-world commercial products to deliver concrete business impact. 
 The total target annual compensation for this position ranges from $127,000 to $225,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise. 
 About the ideal candidate : 
 A PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field (or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in related security fields). 
 Deep theoretical and practical understanding of advanced system-level security and privacy protection technologies, with proven expertise in at least one of the following: identity and access control, authentication, authorization, data sanitization, data loss prevention (DLP), information flow control, or confidential computing. 
 Deep technical insight into AI-specific security engineering and protection mechanisms, with a solid track record in at least one of the following domains: safety alignment, safety benchmarking, data poisoning protection, robust learning, backdoor detection, prompt injection protection, RAG security, or memory security. 
 Demonstrated experience in designing, architecting, and developing robust security and privacy protection solutions for complex AI systems; direct engineering experience in AI Agent development or agentic framework security is considered a significant asset. 
 Strong foundations in fundamental cryptographic concepts, including symmetric-key cryptography (block ciphers, MAC, and authenticated encryption) and public-key cryptography (digital signatures, encryption, and key establishment). 
 Proficiency in at least one of the following core programming languages: C/C++, Java, or Python.

 All applications for this position are reviewed directly by our hiring team, we do not use artificial intelligence tools to screen or select candidates.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft's Customer Care Operations team handles more than 1.7 million customer interactions every month. We support riders, drivers, and businesses across voice, chat, and messaging, through in-house teams and a global network of outsourced partners.
 As Senior Manager, Global Workforce & Partner Management, you'll own how our global workforce is sized, scheduled, funded, and protected. You'll turn demand into capacity, manage the spend behind it, and own the business relationship with our outsourced partners. You'll work hand in hand with the Support Operations leaders who own service delivery and quality, giving them the plans, insights, and partner capacity they need to deliver for customers. Reporting to the Director, Global Strategy & Operations, you'll lead Forecasting, Financial Planning & Management, and Workforce Management, including Scheduling & Real-Time Operations.
 Responsibilities: 
 Plan the workforce. Own short- and long-range forecasting and capacity planning across channels, queues, languages, and lines of business. Lock and deliver rolling billable hour forecasts to our partners, so they can staff accurately and we can hold them accountable to the plan. Build the models behind our annual and half-year plans, and stress-test them as the business and AI adoption evolve.
 Hold teams accountable to the plan. Make sure in-house and partner teams staff to the forecast, schedule to requirements, and keep agents adherent and productive. Own forecast accuracy, staffing to plan, schedule adherence, occupancy, and shrinkage.
 Manage the queues. Monitor handle time, resolution time, and wait times in real time. When wait times degrade or a mass defect hits, lead urgent queue management to protect customers.
 Give leadership clear visibility. Set the goals, scorecards, and business reviews that show how we're performing on staffing, cost, and partner health. Develop and communicate concise, evidence-based narratives for leadership.
 Own workforce spend. Manage the Customer Care workforce budget with Finance across both internal and outsourced agents. Track cost per contact and the drivers behind it, such as headcount, overtime, and utilization. Govern partner billing end to end, including billable hours, rate structures, invoice accuracy, and performance-based credits.
 Own the partner business relationship. Manage the commercial side of our BPO partnerships, including contracts, governance cadences, executive business reviews, and commercial escalations. Partner with Procurement on new agreements and renewals.
 Be a trusted partner to Support Operations. Work alongside the support operations leaders who own service delivery and quality, so their customer goals and KPIs are met. Surface the insights that move productivity, wait times, and customer experience, and turn them into action together.
 Shape our footprint and resilience. Influence where work is done and by whom, including vendor allocation, site strategy, and location mix. Plan and test business continuity so capacity can shift quickly when disruptions hit.
 See around corners. Serve as Customer Care's primary point of contact with Product, Tech, and business leaders on what's changing across Lyft, from ride volume and AI improvements to launches, global growth, integrations, and new partnerships. Size and scope the support impact early so we're staffed, funded, and ready from day one.
 Make the case for investment. Size opportunities, articulate trade-offs, and build the business cases that fund strategic priorities.
 Build a best-in-class function. Get the most out of our workforce management tools and tech stack. Automate manual work, improve data and reporting, and make planning faster and more accurate.
 Build the team, inside and out. Hire, develop, and lead a team of managers and analysts, with clear ownership across a function where finance, operations, and technology meet. Extend that leadership to the workforce teams at our outsourced partners by setting clear goals for productivity, staffing, and scheduling.
 Experience: 
 10+ years in contact center workforce management, support operations, or operations strategy, including 5+ years leading managers.
 A track record of owning workforce planning for a large, global, multi-channel, multi-language operation with both in-house and outsourced teams.
 Expert command of workforce execution metrics, including forecast accuracy, staffing to plan, adherence, occupancy, shrinkage, handle time, and wait time. You know how to hold in-house and partner teams accountable to them and how to stabilize queues quickly when things go wrong.
 Experience owning the commercial relationship with BPO partners at enterprise scale, including contracts, billing models, footprint, and site decisions.
 A strong financial foundation. You've owned a workforce budget across internal and outsourced agents, managed cost per contact, and can turn capacity models into a clear story for Finance and senior leadership.
 Experience leading through influence, both with support operations leaders whose goals you help deliver and with partner teams you don't directly manage.
 Experience sizing the support impact of growth, launches, integrations, or new partnerships, ideally in a marketplace or platform business.
 Experience building business continuity plans across multiple vendors and regions.
 Hands-on experience with enterprise WFM tools, plus a builder's mindset for automating manual work and improving data and reporting.
 Practical AI fluency. You understand how automation changes demand, staffing, and partner economics, and you can lead teams through that shift.
 You're a trusted partner to Finance, Product, Tech, and Operations, and you're clear, direct, and decisive.

Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e-commerce for everyday shoppers.
 Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job.
 You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it.
 You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters.
 What you'll do 
 Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.
 Build the data foundation those workflows depend on in Databricks: Unity Catalog tables and views, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakeflow Connect ingestion from systems like HubSpot, and Genie spaces that let business teams ask questions in plain language. Bring data from our ad-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust.
 Work with Data Science to make agent quality measurable: evaluation sets, accuracy and drift tracking, cost and latency instrumentation, and the audit fields and failure alerts every production workflow carries.
 Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point-to-point automations with maintained, observable ones.
 Partner with Core Engineering to expose platform data and actions as APIs, so agents and business teams can use them directly instead of routing requests through engineers.
 Build reusable pieces, not one-offs: Claude skills, MCP connectors, prompt and evaluation libraries, and playbooks that other builders across Fluent can pick up.
 Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT & Security on credentials and access.
 Demo weekly, write things down in Confluence, and share what you learn in brown bags and tech talks.
 Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work.
 What success looks like 
 In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be.
 3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL.
 You have built and shipped at least one LLM-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation.
 Hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly.
 Experience integrating SaaS and internal systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth.
 You test your work, instrument it, and care about cost. You know when a workflow is ready to be owned by someone else.
 You communicate clearly with people who do not write code, and you are comfortable running a working session with a business team.
 Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of a modern engineering workflow.
 Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Nice to have 
 Databricks Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Model Serving, Vector Search), Genie, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakebase, or Databricks Apps.
 Building MCP servers, or working with the Claude Developer Platform or Agent SDK.
 Workflow orchestration tools such as n8n.
 Integrations with HubSpot, Zendesk, NetSuite, or Jira.
 Experience in ad tech, performance marketing, or another environment that handles regulated consumer data.

Senior AI Engineer — NetSpeek 
 NetSpeek is the agentic control plane for enterprise physical infrastructure . We govern how AI agents reason about, decide on, and execute actions across enterprise endpoints. Our reasoning and execution layer — Lena — sits in customer production environments, where reliability, observability, and auditability are non-negotiable.
 The Senior AI Engineer owns Lena's reasoning layer end-to-end: retrieval, grounding, evaluation, and the boundary between AI suggestions and governed actions.
 What you'll work on
 Designing and improving RAG pipelines for grounding Lena's diagnostic reasoning in structured operational telemetry, device state, and product documentation.
 Building evaluation harnesses that measure groundedness, hallucination, refusal calibration, and action accuracy on every release.
 Setting the boundary between Lena's probabilistic reasoning and the platform's deterministic action layer — what she's allowed to do, when, and under what audit.
 Owning AI cost and latency budgets per workflow.
 Partnering with backend (.NET) and platform engineers to land changes safely.
 You're a fit if 
 You have 5+ years of ML / applied AI engineering experience.
 You've built and shipped production LLM systems (RAG, agents, structured outputs, evaluations) at a B2B SaaS company.
 You've owned a production RAG system end-to-end.
 You've built evaluation pipelines that ran on every release and caught real regressions.
 You've worked at a growth-stage AI-native SaaS company where AI was the primary product.
 You probably aren't a fit if 
 Your AI exposure stops at experimentation or coursework.
 You haven't deployed AI systems to customer production environments.
 You want a process-heavy environment where decisions go through committees.
 How to apply
 We prefer applications through our hiring site: https://build.netspeek.ai/roles/senior-ai-engineer 
There are three paths there, and we prioritize them in this order: 
1. Incident Lab / Case Study —work through a real scenario for this role and send your reasoning with the application. Read first. The scenario gives us the most signal on how you actually think. 
2. Field Note —a single written take instead of the scenario. Read second. Faster than the lab, still a strong signal. 
3. Standard application —resume and the basics through the site's apply form. Read third. Applying directly through Workable below also works, and we'll still read it. The site's three paths exist because they give us better context for the read.
 Either path is read by a human on our hiring team. No AI scoring, no auto-rejection.
 Read the Engineering Handbook and How We Evaluate before applying.
After an offer
 We run standard pre-employment checks before your start date: identity verification, right-to-work confirmation, employment verification, and (where lawful and role-relevant) a criminal record check. We don't run credit checks or online reputation scoring. 
 Must-have
 5+ years in machine learning engineering, or 5+ years combined across ML and applied AI systems
 2+ years building and shipping LLM-powered systems in a growth-phase AI SaaS company where AI was the product, not a side feature
 Hands-on experience with RAG systems including vector databases, embedding tuning, and retrieval optimization
 Experience building evaluation pipelines for LLM performance, hallucination, and reliability in production
 Strong Python with production-level ML system implementation
 Track record operating under real product constraints: latency, cost, observability, and safety
 Comfortable being accountable for AI behavior in production
 Strong signal
 Designed agentic workflows with measurable performance improvements
 Worked at AI-native startups that scaled from early traction to growth stage
 Reduced hallucination and improved grounding in production systems
 Cost optimization at scale, including token modeling and caching strategies
 Familiarity with compliance-aware AI logging and enterprise audit requirements
 Defined evaluation pipelines before feature release rather than after
 Not the right fit if
 Your LLM experience is limited to experimentation, side projects, or non-production systems
 You are a backend engineer looking to pivot into AI
 Your background is research-focused without production ownership
 Your AI work has not operated under real customer impact
 We are growth-stage and fully remote, not late-stage. We invest in the work, the tools, and the people, not the manifesto.
 What that looks like in practice:
 Flexible / unlimited time off
 Health insurance
 Equity participation, discussed at offer
 Fully remote
 Architectural ownership of work that ships to real enterprise customers
 Direct working relationships with the people setting platform strategy
 A growth-stage platform where the decisions you make in your first year shape the product for years
 AI-assisted tooling licensed by NetSpeek (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable)

About Moment Energy 
 Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it. 
 Energy should be free. Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone. 
 The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy. 
 Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact. 
 We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale. 
 Now is the moment. Join us. 
 The Opportunity 
 We are seeking a Mechanical Engineering Co-op to join our Engineering team starting in January 2027. In this role, you will support the design, development, and testing of our battery energy storage systems while gaining hands-on experience working alongside experienced engineers.
 You will contribute to mechanical design, fabrication, testing, and documentation while helping bring new products from concept through prototype and testing. This is a great opportunity for a student who enjoys hands-on work and wants to apply mechanical engineering principles to real-world clean energy technology.
 Responsibilities and Duties 
 Support the mechanical design and integration of battery energy storage systems
 Use 3D CAD software to create models and develop detailed mechanical drawings
 Contribute to the research, development, and improvement of mechanical subsystems
 Assist with hands-on fabrication and assembly of enclosures and subsystems
 Perform basic mechanical and electrical assembly tasks including installing fasteners, connectors, and wiring harnesses
 Assist in mechanical and system-level testing and document results
 Produce design documentation, test documentation, and FMEA documentation
 Support mechanical builds, prototype testing, and troubleshooting during development
 Collaborate with engineers to ensure products are reliable, manufacturable, and ready for production
 The Student we’re looking for: 
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline
 Strong preference for students with design team or previous co-op experience
 Strong preference for students available for an 8-month co-op term
 Experience with 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar)
 Career interest in mechanical design, prototyping, and product development
 Hands-on experience with fabrication, assembly, or prototyping (school projects, labs, or personal projects are acceptable)
 Understanding of mechanical drawings, tolerancing, and engineering documentation
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
 Detail-oriented with good documentation and communication skills
 Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment
 The Experience You’ll Gain: 
 Hands-on experience developing real subsystems used in energy storage systems
 Mentorship from experienced professional mechanical engineers
 Exposure to product development, prototyping, and testing
 The opportunity to contribute to technology supporting the clean energy transition
 Moment Energy Co-op Benefits Highlights 
 Paid Time Off: Co-op’s receive three paid days off per term 
 Vibrant Culture & Perks: Open and collaborative office culture, frequent company socials and wellness programs (weekly yoga and fitness center), and free EV charging on-site. 
 Why join us? 
 Today, we’re delivering 5x the energy density and have all the certifications needed to ship energy independence to the world. 
 Be part of a mission-driven company focused on creating sustainable energy solutions and making a positive impact on the world. 
 Collaborate closely with passionate co-founders and a team committed to innovation and excellence. 
 Contribute to building and scaling a company from the ground up, where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact. 
 Thrive in a workplace that values collaboration, wellness, and celebrating successes, with regular company socials, fitness sessions, and more. 
 We're a fast-paced and dynamic team. 
 Every day you'll be taking on a new challenge and learning something new. You'll take on a wide breadth of tasks and contribute to disrupting the battery industry. You'll be part of a tight-knit team that is working together to save the planet! Fun, health, and wellness are incorporated into our daily schedule and we encourage all our team members to bring innovative ideas to the table to create an interactive workplace. 
 Moment Energy Benefits Highlights (full time, permanent employees only) 
 Financial Growth: Employee equity and a robust RRSP matching program. 
 Comprehensive Health Coverage: Extended health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents through Manulife.
 Generous Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off plus a paid company closure between Christmas and New Year's, with a generous paid sick leave.
 Vibrant Culture & Perks: Open and collaborative office culture, frequent company socials and wellness programs (weekly yoga/fitness), and free EV charging on-site.
 Company Dinner: Weekly Tuesday dinner provided by Moment Energy. We also have a generous supply of coffee and snacks for the office! 
 Our Commitments 
 Moment Energy is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes, including our work environment. We especially welcome applications from Indigenous peoples, members of racialized communities, persons with disabilities, women, and persons who identify as 2SLGBTQ+. 
 —--- 
 Our Values 
 Our values are key to how we show up every day at Moment Energy! We keep them in the forefront of what we do, and they’re used everywhere. We refer to them when we have tough decisions to make, we give shoutouts based on living out these values, and we include them as part of our performance reviews. 
 We have 5 core values and 1 foundational pillar (Safety is our Foundation) which lays the groundwork for everything we do. 
 Safety is our Foundation 
 We prioritize the safety of our products, customers, employees, and the general public above all else. From the workshop to the field, we maintain the highest standards for our batteries in testing manufacturing and deployment, and daily operations. Safety is not only about procedures—it is about vigilance, responsibility, and speaking up when something does not feel right. 
 Safety is everyone's responsibility. We follow safety protocols, use proper equipment, and continuously improve our systems to prevent risks before they occur. If something is unsafe, we stop work and address it. 
 Safety also means protecting our colleagues, customers, and communities by designing reliable products, maintaining safe workspaces, and ensuring our work is done carefully and responsibly. 
 We’re Building a Greener Future Together: 
 We infuse passion for our cleantech mission into every aspect of our work and incorporate fun into the workplace. We motivate one another, celebrate our successes and embrace eco-friendly practices to reduce our carbon footprint. 
 We Prioritize our Customer’s Needs: 
 We place our customers at the core of everything we do, ensuring that every decision considers their needs and aims to provide increased value to them. We provide reliable support for our customers, every step of the way. 
 We’re Open, Honest and Accountable: 
 We prioritize open and honest communication to foster mutual understanding, strengthen knowledge sharing, and reduce miscommunication within the team. We admit when we’ve made a mistake, and remedy our actions. We transparently communicate outcomes whether good, bad, or unexpected. 
 We Think and Act like Owners: 
 We’re self-starters that proactively embrace new challenges along with personal and collective ownership of responsibilities in the organization. We focus on growth, not titles, and we do what needs to be done. 
 We Treat Everyone with Respect: 
 We actively listen, share openly, and work together towards common goals. We treat one another with mutual respect to cultivate an inclusive environment where everyone feels accepted, supported, and heard. We keep an open mind and are willing to learn.

WHAT'S THE ROLE 
 Quality and compliance work best when they’re built into how the business operates, not treated as a checklist before the next audit.
 We're looking for our next Manager, Quality & Integrated Management Systems , to help Dexterra strengthen and continually improve our enterprise approach to quality, compliance and certification. Supporting our ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified programs, you’ll work across the organization to keep our systems effective, our documentation and evidence audit-ready, and our teams prepared for internal, external, surveillance and recertification audits.
 Just as importantly, this isn’t a policing role. You’ll be a trusted partner and practical guide to operations and business leaders, helping teams understand what good looks like, navigate requirements and turn quality standards into processes that work in the real world.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Keep us audit and certification ready. Coordinate internal, external, surveillance and recertification audits, bringing together the right people, documentation, evidence and follow-up to support successful outcomes.
 Strengthen our Integrated Management System. Help govern and continually improve the systems supporting ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, identifying gaps, risks, duplication and opportunities to make our approach more effective.
 Partner with the business. Work closely with Operations, HSE, Sustainability, HR, Technology and other teams, providing practical guidance that helps them meet quality and compliance requirements without losing sight of operational realities.
 Turn findings into improvement. Track audit findings, non-conformances, corrective actions and risks, support root-cause analysis, and help ensure actions are completed and actually solve the underlying issue.
 Bring order to documentation and evidence. Strengthen document and records control so procedures, records and audit evidence are current, accessible, traceable and ready when they’re needed.
 Use data to see what’s coming. Analyze audit results, incidents, records, client feedback and process performance to spot trends, systemic risks and opportunities for improvement.
 Make quality easier to work with. Improve procedures, templates, forms, workflows and tools so our quality and compliance systems are practical, consistent and useful to the people who rely on them every day.
 Help teams build capability. Coach and support business and functional teams as they develop procedures, work instructions and records, providing clear standards without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 You’re an experienced quality professional who understands that strong compliance comes from partnership , influence and good systems , not simply enforcing rules.
 5+ years of progressive experience supporting or managing quality, integrated management systems, ISO, auditing or compliance, ideally within a complex corporate or multi-site organization.
 Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, including audits, documented information, corrective action, management review and continual improvement.
 Hands-on experience coordinating internal and external audits, certification or recertification activities, and the follow-up that keeps organizations ready year-round.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to work with senior leaders, operational teams, auditors and cross-functional partners.
 A practical, collaborative approach. You can challenge a process or identify a gap without becoming the “quality police,” and you know how to bring people with you.
 Strong organization and follow-through, particularly when coordinating multiple audits, corrective actions, documentation requirements and deadlines.
 The ability to identify patterns and root causes, looking beyond individual findings to improve the broader system.
 Comfort working with technology and data, including Microsoft 365 and tools used to manage documentation, workflows, reporting and quality information. Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or EHSQ/IMS platforms such as Sphera is an asset.
 ISO internal auditor training in at least one of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 or ISO 45001, or a willingness to complete it within your first 12 months. Lead Auditor training or certification is an asset.

Présentation de l’entreprise 
 Nous fabriquons et fournissons des médicaments et des vaccins fiables et de haute qualité afin de répondre aux besoins des patients et de soutenir notre performance.
 Notre réseau de 37 sites de production de médicaments et de vaccins a livré 1,7 milliard d’unités de médicaments et 409 millions de doses de vaccins en 2024, contribuant ainsi à améliorer la santé de millions de personnes. Notre chaîne d’approvisionnement n’est pas seulement au cœur de nos activités ; elle est essentielle pour mettre nos innovations à la disposition des patients aussi rapidement, efficacement et efficacement que possible. Les technologies de pointe transforment la façon dont nous fabriquons les médicaments et les vaccins, nous permettant d’accroître la rapidité, la qualité et l’ampleur de l’approvisionnement en produits.
 Nous recherchons les meilleurs talents et les plus grandes expertises pour nous accompagner dans notre parcours vers la fabrication de produits de plus en plus complexes. Nous tirons parti des technologies de fabrication intelligente, notamment la robotique, les solutions numériques et l’intelligence artificielle, afin de mieux servir les patients.
 Résumé du poste 
Vous conseillerez et soutiendrez notre site canadien (Ville de Ste Foy) sur les questions de santé, de sécurité au travail et d’environnement. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables du site, les ingénieurs, les équipes des opérations et vos collègues de l’ensemble de l’entreprise afin de prévenir les incidents, réduire les risques et assurer la sécurité de tous. Nous valorisons les personnes qui communiquent clairement, savent écouter, accompagner les autres et faire preuve d’un jugement pratique. Ce rôle offre une occasion d’avoir un impact concret sur le terrain, de contribuer à des projets visibles et de développer vos compétences techniques et en leadership, tout en aidant GSK à unir la science, la technologie et les talents pour devancer la maladie, ensemble.
 Responsabilités 
 Cette fonction vous offrira l’occasion de diriger des activités clés afin de faire progresser votre carrière. Dans le cadre de ce rôle, vous serez notamment appelé(e) à :
 Maintenir et améliorer les programmes de santé, de sécurité et d’environnement (SSE) du site afin d’assurer leur conformité aux lois canadiennes et québécoises ainsi qu’aux normes de l’entreprise.
 Réaliser des évaluations des risques, des inspections en milieu de travail et des contrôles d’hygiène industrielle. Recommander des mesures correctives et en assurer le suivi.
 Enquêter sur les incidents et les quasi-accidents, en déterminer les causes fondamentales et diriger la mise en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives.
 Concevoir et offrir des formations et des activités de sensibilisation en SSE, claires et pratiques, destinées aux opérateurs, aux entrepreneurs et aux équipes du site.
 Fournir une expertise SSE dans le cadre des projets, des modifications de procédés et des activités de mise en service afin de garantir la sécurité des conceptions et des transferts opérationnels.
 Préparer et tenir à jour les dossiers réglementaires, les rapports internes et les indicateurs de performance SSE du site.

Ce poste est offert en mode présentiel ou hybride, sur notre site à Ste Foy, selon les besoins opérationnels. Certaines tâches exigent une présence régulière sur le site, tandis que des modalités de travail hybrides peuvent être envisagées lorsque les activités le permettent. Vous intégrerez une équipe collaborative qui vous soutiendra dans le développement de vos compétences techniques et de votre expérience en leadership.  Compétences requises

 Baccalauréat en génie, en santé et sécurité au travail, en sciences de l’environnement ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Minimum de 5 à 7 ans d’expérience en santé, sécurité et environnement (SSE) dans un contexte manufacturier, de laboratoire, pharmaceutique ou dans un autre environnement réglementé.

 Certification telle que le NEBOSH, le CRSP/CRST, le CSP ou toute autre certification canadienne équivalente en santé et sécurité au travail.
 Expérience en sécurité des procédés chimiques, en surveillance de l’hygiène industrielle ou en gestion de la sécurité des procédés.
 Expérience dans le soutien de projets d’investissement, la gestion du contrôle des changements et la réalisation de revues de conception en SSE.
 Expérience dans l’animation de formations en SSE, la coordination d’exercices d’urgence ou la direction d’équipes d’intervention.
 Capacité démontrée à influencer les opérations et à mettre en œuvre des améliorations mesurables en matière de SSE.

Nous favorisons l’apprentissage et le perfectionnement professionnel afin de soutenir le développement de votre expertise en santé, sécurité et environnement (SSE), ainsi que l’évolution de votre carrière.

Bug Squisher Wanted: You’re an expert at making sure websites, storefronts, and backend systems work smoothly before they go live. But you don’t just catch bugs. You build the systems that catch bugs before anyone else ever sees them. You can spot flaky tests from a mile away. Your test architecture is clean, scalable, and easy for other developers to follow. And when it comes to troubleshooting, you’re relentless — in the best possible way.
 If this sounds like you, and you’re excited about a workday that’s fun, collaborative, technical, and full of purpose, let’s chat!
 AlgaeCal is on the lookout for a Lead QA Developer to bring their skills to our lively QA team and help transform lives, one stable release at a time.
 Small print here ⇒ We’re an eCommerce company. So, we want you to have eCommerce experience. Lots of it. You’ll be helping us improve the quality, stability, and reliability of our React-based storefront and internal middleware. So if automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and digital marketing technology don’t light at least a small fire in your belly, you probably shouldn’t read any further. 
 Still here? Okay then…
 This job will give you ALL the feels: 
 At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.
 The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.
 You’ll love it here: 
 You’ll be working with a great team. The developers at AlgaeCal have been there, done that, and got the t-shirt. They’ve written more code than Alan Turing. They’ve learned more programming languages than C3PO. They’ve immersed themselves in so many development tasks that they’ve had to be pulled out of the Matrix by their ankles on a Friday evening. And the best part? They’re friendly, funny, and easy to work with.
 You’ll use your powers for good. This isn’t one of those jobs that crush your soul with mindless tasks. On the contrary! You’ll help build the quality engineering systems that let us ship better storefront experiences, stronger middleware, and more reliable eCommerce platforms — all so we can spread a powerful message: bone loss is beatable.
 You won’t be micromanaged. We’ll give you a clear set of KPIs, meaningful ownership, and crystal clear expectations. You’ll know what success looks like: stronger automation frameworks, cleaner CI/CD integration, fewer flaky tests, better reporting, and fewer defects slipping through to production.
 We don’t have mattresses at the office. Seriously Elon, what’s up with that?!? You’ll be relieved to know this isn’t one of those Silicon Valley gigs that expects you to work ridiculously long hours and frowns upon family time. We’re not like that! We enjoy our life, and we want you to enjoy yours too.
 This job might be for you if you’ve got… 
 5+ years of QA development experience, with real examples of automated testing strategies you’ve built, maintained, improved, or scaled.
 2+ years of leadership, mentorship, or coaching experience. You don’t need a giant ego or a fancy title. But you do need to know how to guide other QA developers, review their work, support their growth, and raise the technical standard of the team.
 A strong command of JavaScript and TypeScript. You don’t need to speak in code at dinner parties, (in fact, please don’t), but you should be very comfortable writing, reviewing, and improving automated tests in a modern JS/TS environment.
 Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks like Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools. If you’ve ever made a flaky test suite faster, cleaner, and more reliable, we’d love to hear about it.
 The know-how to architect, optimize, and scale automated testing frameworks across frontend storefronts and backend middleware. Around here, that means working across our Shopify Hydrogen storefront and middleware
 Experience integrating automated tests into cloud-based CI/CD pipelines. You understand that automation is only useful if it gives developers fast, reliable feedback, and doesn’t randomly blow up the build because someone sneezed near the test runner.
 A sharp eye for quality metrics. We’re talking automation coverage, pipeline stability, test execution runtimes, flaky test reduction, production defect leakage, and the kind of reporting that helps the whole team make better decisions.
 Comfort with specialized QA spaces like API contract testing, performance profiling, load testing, and browser developer tool profiling. You don’t have to know everything. But you do need to be curious, technical, and willing to dig. We’d also be impressed if you’ve worked with Python, PHP, Figma, Storybook, or Jest.
 Next level bug prevention skills. In fact, you’re so good at dealing with bugs you should probably be deployed on a mission to Klendathu.
 Now, time to be honest: is this really you? 
If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.
 Other Qualities You’ll Need 
 At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities: 
 You’re humble — you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
 You’re hungry to learn more
 You’re people smart — in the sense that you’re a great teammate
 The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.
 What Will You Earn? 
 We believe in rewarding top talent. Let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.
 You’ll also enjoy the following benefits: 
 A generous healthcare package
 Monthly team events and activities
 Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
 Casual dress code
 And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.
 How To Apply 
 So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?
 Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Lead QA Developer is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:
 If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully: 
 Write a cover letter addressing: 
 Why are you the best Lead QA Developer for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements, especially around automation frameworks, CI/CD testing, defect reduction, flaky test reduction, QA metrics, or mentoring other QA developers.
 1. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view 
 2. What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it? 
 3. What are the last three books you’ve read? 
 4. What do you do for fun? 
 5. Explain what you’re doing now for a job: 
 6. If you don’t have one, explain why. 
 7. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere. 
 Upload your cover letter and resume 
 Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
 Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best — and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.
 Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume. 
 Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read! 
 We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly, and you can also expect a prompt response.

About the Role

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers travel for some of the world's largest brands through our APIs, white label products and fintech, and every dataset we hold tells a story our partners need told clearly, repeatedly and fast. As a Senior Data Scientist on HTS you will own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of partners and build the machinery that answers their questions about supply health, pricing competitiveness and performance once, then answers them every week. You will be judged less on the sophistication of your models than on whether the people you work with, inside Hopper and across partner commercial teams, make better decisions because of you.

What would your day-to-day look like

 - Own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of HTS partners, working alongside Partner Success and Commercial to understand what they need, deliver it, and present it directly to their teams

 - Design and templatize repeatable reporting on supply health, pricing competitiveness and tenant performance that scales across hotels, flights, homes and cars without being rebuilt each time

 - Use AI assistants, agents and code generation tools as everyday collaborators to automate the repetitive parts of analysis and reporting, and help the broader team adopt the same practices

 - Frame and run exploratory analyses that deepen our understanding of partner and traveler behavior, and translate what you find into clear recommendations for product, engineering and business leaders

 - Apply machine learning and statistical methods to large, messy datasets where they move the needle, and recognize when a simple, well explained metric is the better answer

 - Build dashboards and self serve reporting in BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude and Google Sheets, with an eye toward making yourself unnecessary for routine questions

 - Partner closely with product and engineering so the data we collect supports the questions our partners will ask next

An ideal candidate has

 - A degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience

 - Extremely strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a track record of answering hard questions with data across more than one domain or product line

 - A proven ability to turn complex technical work into simple, credible narratives for non technical and executive audiences, including external partners

 - Comfort being partner facing, presenting findings, fielding tough questions live and building trust with commercial counterparts

 - Deep SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouses such as BigQuery, plus fluency in Python and Pandas or R for large scale data preparation and analysis

 - Hands on, daily use of LLM based tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot for writing code, SQL, analysis and documentation, and a point of view on where they help and where they fall short

 - Experience building or deploying automated and agentic workflows, from scheduled pipelines to LLM driven report generation and prompt or skill libraries, that turn one off analyses into repeatable products

 - Experience with data mining, machine learning and statistical modeling, and the judgment to know when to reach for them

 - Experience with business reporting and experimentation tools such as Tableau, Looker or Amplitude

 - A strong bias toward simplifying, templatizing and shipping over polishing

 - Travel industry experience in lodging, air, vacation rentals or car rental, or in a marketplace, B2B platform or API distribution business, is a plus

 - Experience with geographic data in search, filtering or recommendation, or working with external customers in a consulting, solutions or customer analytics capacity, is a plus

Perks and benefits of working with us

 - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

 - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan

 - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage

 - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses

 - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue's telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere

 - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay

 - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Carrot Cash travel stipend

 - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

 - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

 - Open communication with management and company leadership

 - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. The successful candidate will assess how these contracts are transacted today, surface the gaps, risks, and operational challenges, and guide the organization on how contract terms, pricing, and obligations should be managed and recorded across our business systems. Working closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, Pricing, Product, and the technical owners of our business systems, the Contract Manager will mature contract management into a scalable, well-documented, and auditable capability, and will actively drive higher revenue and transaction volume through these contract vehicles.
